title: Time travel queries now enforce ABAC policies (Beta)
body: This feature is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Starting in Databricks Runtime 19, you can use time travel on qualifying Unity Catalog managed tables while enforcing ABAC row filter and column mask policies. See [Time travel with ABAC policies](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/abac/time-travel).
